:::{#def-noise}
#### Noise of an outcome conditional on covariates

Let $\paren{\Predvar, \Outvar}$ be the [covariate](#def-covariate) and the outcome of one observation from a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population),
and let $\truemean$ be the [mean function](#def-mean-function) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$.

The **[noise](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/noise)** $\noise$ of $\Outvar$ conditional on $\Predvar$
is the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean)
of the outcome $\Outvar$ from the mean function value $\truemeanf{\Predvar}$ at the observation's own covariate value:

$$
\noise \eqdef \Outvar - \truemeanf{\Predvar}.
$$ {#eq-noise}

:::
